top.why_it_likely_worked_or_not: It likely opened strongly: the first line leads with three concrete numbers from a customer onboarding project, the only numeric hook this week. It was also posted on a Tuesday morning (08:10 UTC), like most of your better posts.

It likely drew comments because it ends with a direct question ("What's the one meeting you'd cut?"): 64 comments, the most of any post this period. Short text and a morning slot (08:05 UTC) match your other strong posts.

bottom.why_it_likely_worked_or_not: It is likely too long for its hook: about 1,900 characters of story before the point appears, and it went out on Friday evening (17:45 UTC), outside the morning slot of your better posts.

It is a link post whose text only announces a blog article; clicks were the highest of the week (25) but reactions and comments were low, which likely means readers left for the article instead of engaging with the post.
